python3 << 'EOF'
import zipfile, re
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

ns = {'m': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'}

with zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx') as z:
    print("Files in archive:")
    for n in z.namelist():
        print("  ", n)

    # shared strings
    shared = []
    if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in z.namelist():
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
        for si in root.findall('m:si', ns):
            shared.append(''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t')))

    # workbook sheets order
    wb = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
    sheets = [(s.get('name'), s.get('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id'))
              for s in wb.find('m:sheets', ns)]
    print("\nSheets:", sheets)

    # map rels
    rels = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels'))
    relmap = {r.get('Id'): r.get('Target') for r in rels}

    for name, rid in sheets:
        target = relmap[rid]
        path = 'xl/' + target.lstrip('/')
        print(f"\n=== Sheet: {name} ({path}) ===")
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read(path))
        for row in root.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}row'):
            vals = []
            for c in row.findall('m:c', ns):
                ref = c.get('r')
                t = c.get('t')
                v = c.find('m:v', ns)
                f = c.find('m:f', ns)
                if f is not None:
                    vals.append(f"={f.text}")
                elif v is None:
                    vals.append("")
                elif t == 's':
                    vals.append(shared[int(v.text)])
                else:
                    vals.append(v.text)
            print(ref[:2], vals)

arguments.content:
import zipfile
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

NS = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
REL = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships'

with zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx') as z:
    print("Files in archive:")
    for n in z.namelist():
        print("  ", n)

    shared = []
    if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in z.namelist():
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
        for si in root.findall(f'{{{NS}}}si'):
            shared.append(''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter(f'{{{NS}}}t')))

    wb = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
    sheets = [(s.get('name'), s.get(f'{{{REL}}}id'))
              for s in wb.find(f'{{{NS}}}sheets')]
    print("\nSheets:", sheets)

    rels = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels'))
    relmap = {r.get('Id'): r.get('Target') for r in rels}

    for name, rid in sheets:
        target = relmap[rid]
        path = 'xl/' + target.lstrip('/')
        print(f"\n=== Sheet: {name} ({path}) ===")
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read(path))
        for row in root.iter(f'{{{NS}}}row'):
            vals = []
            for c in row.findall(f'{{{NS}}}c'):
                ref = c.get('r')
                t = c.get('t')
                v = c.find(f'{{{NS}}}v')
                f = c.find(f'{{{NS}}}f')
                if f is not None:
                    vals.append(f"={f.text}")
                elif v is None:
                    vals.append("")
                elif t == 's':
                    vals.append(shared[int(v.text)])
                else:
                    vals.append(v.text)
            print(ref[:2], vals)
